name: ai-software-delivery-room
description: Multi-agent software delivery for Claude: discovery (brief, roadmap, business case, use cases), architecture, sprint execution with a plan→build→independent-QA triad, product-integrity traceability with drift detection and cross-sprint regression, live Cypress E2E, git workflow, and context discipline (measured facts, contract pre-flight, budgeted context packs), per-agent runtime tiers with AX-style Task/Workspace/Gateway/Model blocks, a design-system stage, and companion detection (UI UX Pro Max, Ponytail, Graphify). The state machine lives in scripts, not the model's memory.
